en.title: System API tokens
en.subtitle: Issue scoped bearer tokens for scripts. Tokens access only the APIs and resources granted below; model calls continue to use model API keys.

empty.title: No system tokens
empty.body: Create a token for a script or an integration.

en.modelKeyIndependence: Model API keys remain independent. A key created here keeps its own expiry, quota and model limits if this token is later revoked or expires.

editor.subtitle: Choose the APIs this token may call. Your current account permissions still apply.
editor.name: Name
editor.adminHint: Administrator scopes can access user-facing and administrative APIs currently allowed for your account.
editor.userHint: User scopes are limited to your own account and resources.
editor.allowIpsHint: One IP address or CIDR per line
editor.allowIpsDescription: Leave empty to allow any source IP. Trusted proxy settings determine the client IP.
editor.enabledHint: Disabled tokens cannot access system APIs.

issued.title: Token created
issued.description: {{name}} is ready. The secret is shown once.
issued.exampleHint: Set these environment variables locally. This example requires billing:read.
issued.copyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select and copy it manually.
issued.warning: Store this token securely now. It cannot be retrieved from the console later.

revoke.allDescription: All of your system tokens will stop working immediately. Model API keys are unaffected.
revoke.title: Revoke token?
revoke.description: {{name}} will stop working immediately. This does not revoke any model API keys created with it.

errors.catalog: Could not load the permission catalog.
errors.adminPolicy: Could not load the token policy.
errors.invalidForm: Check the name, expiry, permissions and allowed IP addresses.
errors.recentAuthentication: For security, sign in again before creating this token or expanding its permissions. Your draft will be restored after login.
errors.draftStorage: The draft could not be kept for reauthentication. Please retry in a fresh login.
errors.proof: Verification failed. Confirm your current session and try again.
errors.scopeDenied: Your account no longer has one or more selected permissions.
errors.conflict: This token was changed elsewhere. Refresh the list before editing again.
errors.capacity: You have reached the token limit. Revoke an unused token, then retry.
errors.disabled: The administrator has disabled system access tokens.
errors.issuanceDisabled: The administrator has paused new token issuance.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait briefly, then retry.
errors.save: The token could not be saved. Your entered values are still in the form.
errors.revoke: The token could not be revoked. Try again.

admin.title: Token controls
admin.hint: These controls affect system API tokens only; model API keys are not changed.
admin.confirmDisableBody: New requests using system tokens will be rejected. Model API keys and accepted background tasks are unaffected.
admin.userId: Revoke all tokens for user ID
admin.confirmRevokeBody: All system access tokens for user {{userId}} will stop working immediately.
admin.modelKeysIndependent: Revoking system tokens does not disable model API keys or cancel accepted background tasks.

zh.title: 系统 API 令牌
zh.subtitle: 为脚本创建按权限限制的 Bearer 令牌。令牌只能访问授予的接口和资源；模型调用继续使用模型 API Key。

empty.title: 还没有系统令牌
empty.body: 创建一个供脚本或系统集成使用的令牌。

zh.modelKeyIndependence: 模型 API Key 独立有效。通过此令牌创建的 Key 使用自己的有效期、额度和模型限制；此令牌过期或撤销不会影响它。

editor.subtitle: 选择此令牌可调用的接口。接口仍受当前账号权限限制。
editor.name: 名称
editor.adminHint: 管理员权限可访问当前账号获准的用户端及后台接口。
editor.userHint: 普通用户权限仅限本人账户及资源。
editor.allowIps: 允许的 IP 地址（可选）
editor.allowIpsHint: 每行一个 IP 地址或 CIDR
editor.allowIpsDescription: 留空表示允许任意来源 IP。客户端 IP 由可信代理设置决定。
editor.enabledHint: 停用后不能再访问系统 API。

issued.title: 令牌已创建
issued.description: {{name}} 已就绪。完整令牌只展示一次。
issued.exampleHint: 请在本地设置这些环境变量。此示例需要 billing:read 权限。
issued.copyFailed: 无法复制令牌，请手动选中复制。
issued.warning: 请立即安全保存。之后无法从控制台再次查看完整令牌。

revoke.allDescription: 你的全部系统访问令牌将立即失效，模型 API Key 不受影响。
revoke.title: 撤销令牌？
revoke.description: {{name}} 将立即失效。由它创建的模型 API Key 不受影响。

errors.invalidForm: 请检查名称、有效期、权限和允许的 IP 地址。
errors.recentAuthentication: 为安全起见，创建令牌或扩大权限前需要重新登录；登录后会恢复草稿。
errors.draftStorage: 无法保存草稿以便重新登录，请在重新登录后重试。
errors.proof: 操作未通过验证，请重新登录后重试。
errors.scopeDenied: 当前账号已不再具备所选的部分权限。
errors.conflict: 此令牌已在其他位置更新，请刷新列表后重新编辑。
errors.capacity: 已达到令牌上限，请先撤销不再使用的令牌后重试。
errors.disabled: 管理员已停用系统访问令牌。
errors.issuanceDisabled: 管理员已暂停签发新令牌。
errors.rateLimited: 请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。
errors.save: 令牌保存失败，表单内容已保留。

admin.title: 令牌控制
admin.hint: 这些设置仅影响系统 API 令牌，不会修改模型 API Key。
admin.revokedCount: 已撤销 {{count}} 个系统访问令牌。
admin.confirmDisableBody: 之后的系统令牌请求会被拒绝。模型 API Key 和已受理后台任务不受影响。
admin.userId: 撤销用户 ID 的全部令牌
admin.confirmRevokeBody: 用户 {{userId}} 的全部系统访问令牌将立即失效。
admin.modelKeysIndependent: 撤销系统令牌不会停用模型 API Key，也不会取消已受理的后台任务。
